name: Student Guild Placement Care Pack
provider: Griffith University Gold Coast Student Guild
summary: A pack of everyday essentials for Gold Coast students who relocate or cut work hours for unpaid placement.
who: Students who must relocate outside the Gold Coast and/or reduce paid work hours for an unpaid placement.
how: Use the online application form on the Student Guild's essential support page.

source.label: Griffith University Gold Coast Student Guild: Essential support

evidence.quote: you can apply for a placement care package to help you with everyday essentials. One pack per student.
